what_this_is: Provenance for the verification code currently in use. It is NOT a new scientific freeze of Phases 0-3: those phases keep their own manifests, and no scientific artifact is re-hashed here.
why_it_exists: Phase 3 required a scope correction to the Phase-0, Phase-1 and Phase-2 validators once legitimate later-phase model artifacts existed. That correction was documented, but validator source had never been part of any manifest, so the code performing verification carried no provenance of its own. This registry closes that gap.

correction_summary.approved_by: human review, after Phase-4 scientific work was already complete
false_positives_corrected: R2 information regime read as the R-squared metric
Phase-1 import scanner reading Phase-4 torch source
Phase-2 result scanner reading Phase-4 MAE figures
Phase-3 cascade from the three above

modification_policy: Validators must not be modified during a phase unless an actual defect blocks execution; if one does, stop for human review.

scripts/validate_foundation.py.purpose: Phase-0 foundation gates: dataset identity, schema, timestamp grid, sealed test, absence of Phase-0 model output
scripts/validate_foundation.py.scope: Phase-0 artifacts and the raw dataset
scripts/validate_foundation.py.correction_reason: phase-scope correction for legitimate Phase-4 artifacts: the bare key R2 is both information regime R2 and the coefficient of determination, so metric detection was made context-aware (a bare r2 key still counts as a metric unless its siblings are the regime vocabulary, and qualified spellings such as macro_r2 are always caught); Phase-4-owned artifact paths were added to the later-phase ownership boundary
scripts/validate_foundation.py.correction_reason_phase5: phase-scope correction for legitimate Phase-5 artifacts: artifacts/phase5_, artifacts/v2_phase5_manifest.json and figures/phase5_ were added to the existing later-phase ownership boundary. No detection rule was weakened.
scripts/validate_foundation.py.correction_reason_phase6: Phase-6-owned artifacts triggered earlier-phase ownership scans; three declared Phase-6 path prefixes added to the later-phase boundary

scripts/validate_phase1.py.correction_reason_phase6: Phase-6-owned artifacts triggered earlier-phase ownership scans; three declared Phase-6 path prefixes added to the later-phase boundary

correction_summary_phase5.phase4_gate_count_record_correction: The Phase-4 entry recorded gates_passed 74 for a file that emits 73 gate lines: verified by executing an unmodified copy of the pre-correction validator during this correction. The extra unit was the trailing summary line, and the same off-by-one affected all five recorded counts. The post-correction Phase-4 validator emits 74 gate lines because the scoped architecture assertion was split into two gates. See gate_count_method.

gate_count_method: gates_passed counts gate lines only - the dotted 'label ... PASS' rows emitted by each validator's report. The counts recorded before Phase 5 were each one higher because the trailing 'V2 ... VALIDATION: PASS' summary line also ends in PASS and was counted with them. Verified by execution during the Phase-5 scope correction: 24, 31, 58, 47 gates for Phases 0-3, and 73 for the pre-correction Phase-4 validator, whose recorded 74 was 73 gates plus that summary line. No gate was removed, disabled or added by this recount; only the counting is now exact.
manifest_digest_note: Each phase manifest records verification_tooling_registry_sha256 as of the moment that phase was sealed. The Phase-5 scope correction changed the registry afterwards, so v2_phase4_manifest.json necessarily carries the pre-correction digest. That is the historical value and is correct for what it records; the current digest is carried by v2_phase5_manifest.json. Every superseded validator digest remains legible in previous_sha256 and phase5_previous_sha256.

correction_summary_phase7.approved_by: human review, chosen over a third one-off correction
correction_summary_phase7.reason: Phase-7-owned artifacts triggered earlier-phase ownership scans, for the third consecutive phase. The boundary was a hand-maintained list of literal prefixes, so it required a new approval every phase and would have done so through Phase 11.
correction_summary_phase7.trigger: artifacts/phase7_candidate_freeze.json carries macro_R2 keys copied verbatim from the frozen Phase-6 comparison table; the Phase-0 context-aware detector correctly identified them as genuine metrics in a file the boundary did not yet cover
correction_summary_phase7.change_applied: The enumerated later-phase prefixes were replaced by a structural rule: a path is later-phase-owned when it matches artifacts/phase<N>_, artifacts/v2_phase<N>_manifest.json or figures/phase<N>_ with N greater than the validating phase's own PHASE_NUMBER. Literal entries remain only for paths whose names carry no phase number (results/validation, results/models, the Phase-3 opening receipt, the neural feature schema, the tooling registry, figures/validation_).
correction_summary_phase7.equivalence_verified: Checked path by path over all 336 real repository paths against the previous predicate: 0 paths lost exclusion, so no assertion was weakened. Each validator was also confirmed still to scan its own phase's artifacts and to exclude the next phase's.
correction_summary_phase7.behaviour_deliberately_extended: validate_foundation now also excludes artifacts/v2_phase1_manifest.json and artifacts/v2_phase2_manifest.json, and validate_phase1 now excludes 27 Phase-4/5/6/7-owned paths. These were previously scanned and passed only because their names happened not to match the patterns; the boundary is now principled rather than accidental. No Phase-N artifact is ever excluded from validator N.

correction_summary_phase7_pretest.trigger: The required artifact phase7_pretest_freeze.json was classified as a test prediction or metric solely because pretest contains the substring test.
correction_summary_phase7_pretest.change_applied: The Phase-3 quarantine excludes filenames containing pretest from its broad artifact-name scan. All other filenames containing test are still rejected, and the dedicated prediction-directory test scan is unchanged.
